subject: [PATCH v3 07/12] mm/collapse: name the per-table scan reset for what it resets

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch renames the function collapse_control_init_scan() to collapse_scan_reset(), which more accurately reflects its purpose of resetting accumulated data for a scan, including node load, allocation nodemask, and eligible PTE bitmap. This change is part of a larger effort to improve naming conventions in the code and prepare for future changes that will involve initialization and release functions for each control. The patch does not introduce any functional changes.
